June 11, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Melvin Capital Management Lp decreased its stake in Yandex N V (YNDX) by 43.48% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Melvin Capital Management Lp sold 1.00 million shares as the company’s stock declined 20.74% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.30 million shares of the programming company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $51.29M, down from 2.30 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Melvin Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Yandex N V for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.43B market cap company. The stock increased 1.30% or $0.45 during the last trading session, reaching $35.01. About 656,163 shares traded. Yandex N.V. (NASDAQ:YNDX) has risen 19.66% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending.
